description: PM-6 intent painter. No fixture: from the main menu into the Plan Editor with recon_stomps + hammer_anvil, lay the army out, and paint intents. Asserts the painter is withheld until nothing is left to place; that all five verbs — and only those five — can be applied, one per unit; that HOLD_OBJECTIVE is bound by a REAL board click on the objective marker (ObjectiveVisual has no input handling, so the painter hit-tests the marker positions itself); that every earmark gets a board badge and a panel row, and that Clear removes both. Then it saves and re-reads the file: the five verbs and the bound target survive, the RESERVE_UNTIL unit also appears in deployment.reserves (the validator rejects a mismatch, so this is what proves the recorder reconciles them), the plan validates against the live army, and the AI's own PM-3 lookup returns all five.
